scripts.start: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.serve: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
